summary.en: Add a portrait round table, interface-first setup, distinct character acting directions, quoted grouped clarifications and durable last words/badge handoff.
summary.zh: 新增肖像圆桌、界面优先开局、人物表演指引、带原句的合并澄清，以及可恢复的遗言与警徽交接。

reason: Describe the changed player-facing discussion and exit rules, interface versus driver, character presentation and unverified model-performance limits.

compatibility.en: Snapshots add dialogue_version=1. Missing version restores as 0 and does not introduce last words mid-game. Question pair saves remain readable; clarification limits now apply per recipient/window. Existing characters and credentials are unchanged.
compatibility.zh: 快照新增 dialogue_version=1，旧档缺失时恢复为 0，不在途中插入遗言。旧问题对格式仍可读取，澄清改为每位被问者每窗口一次；人物映射与凭据保持不变。
